response.overview: In 2005, a group of college boys started the LMU Ice Hockey Club. In the years since, they’ve become a staple of ACHA men’s hockey. Now, 20 years later, LMU Women’s Hockey is doing the same. From the studio that brought you “How to be Seen” and “Game Changer,” ROAR Studios presents: “SKATE AT YOUR OWN RISK,” a new documentary film from director Cole Leighton.
response.title: Skate At Your Own Risk
